comment: The first command of the game is a kick with a count of 14. One repeat is answered. Escape at the next repeated "In what direction?" makes getdir() fail, dokick() returns ECMD_CANCEL, and rhack() calls reset_cmd_vars(TRUE): gm.multi goes to zero, which drops the repeats still owed, and CQ_REPEAT is cleared, so the ^A that follows reports that no command is available to repeat. The k after it is a single step. No earlier command has run cmd.c reset_cmd_vars(), so svc.context.run still holds the zero C starts it with: hack.c lookaround(), which allmain.c moveloop_core() calls before each repeat, returns at `svc.context.run == 0` without examining the squares next to the hero. A square there would stop a run. The seed, date and character were chosen for this recipe.
